Additionally, the "Find a Grave" result explicitly listed the death location as "Brighton". Despite this clear evidence, the Planner's analysis in Step 5 (which relied on the WebSurfer's output or the visible data) concluded that the death place was "Hove, Sussex, England" based on a misreading of the Wikipedia page (likely confusing the birth/movement details with the death location or misinterpreting the specific infobox text shown in the screenshot). This error in extracting the correct location from the available search results led the entire process towards the wrong answer ("Hove") instead of the correct answer ("Brighton").
